notes:
CIRCUIT: a chain of six inverting/non-inverting op-amp stages with L or C feedback, driven from two one-port DC sources (+5V at top left, +0V at mid left). Op-amp #4's output feeds 1k #8 into op-amp #7; op-amp #19's output feeds 1k #12 into op-amp #7's other input; op-amp #7's output is the vertical bus at x~577 which fans out to three further stages (#3 via 1k #6, #13 via 1k #14, #24 via 1uF #25). The three final output resistors (#5, #16, #26) all land on the vertical bus at x~998. 28 components, 14 nets.

NET MAP:
  0   = ground: GND symbols #9 #11 #20 #21 #22 #27, the in+ (non-inverting) input of op-amps #3 #4 #13 #19 #24, and the bottom lead of the vertical 1k resistor #17.
  n1  = +5V node / op-amp #4's summing loop: V-DC #0 (the '+5V' arrow), op-amp #4 in- (upper-left lead), op-amp #4 OUT, left lead of 1k resistor #8. Physically the y~257 rail from x=97 to x=270, the x~120 drop to the op-amp's upper lead, and the x~270 drop onto the output wire at S22.
  n2  = op-amp #3's summing node (in-): LEFT lead of 1uH inductor #1, op-amp #3 in- (upper-left, at (683,309)), RIGHT lead of 1k resistor #6.
  n3  = op-amp #3's output node: RIGHT lead of inductor #1, op-amp #3 OUT, LEFT lead of 1k resistor #5. Physically the blob at (785,325) with the x~785 riser to the inductor.
  n4  = op-amp #7's in+ node: LEFT lead of 1uH inductor #2, op-amp #7 in+ (UPPER-left lead at (428,316)), RIGHT lead of 1k resistor #8. Physically the y~317 wire from x=381 to the op-amp bar, with the x~420 riser to the inductor joining at S21.
  n5  = the big vertical bus at x~577 (op-amp #7's output): RIGHT lead of inductor #2, op-amp #7 OUT, LEFT lead of 1k #6, LEFT lead of 1k #14, LEFT plate of 1uF #25. Runs from y~255 down to y~755.
  n6  = the right-hand output bus at x~998: RIGHT lead of 1k #5, RIGHT lead of 1k #16, RIGHT lead of 1k #26.
  n7  = op-amp #7's in- node: op-amp #7 in- (LOWER-left lead at (428,365)), RIGHT lead of 1k #12, TOP lead of the vertical 1k #17. Physically the corner at (423,364) and the x~422 drop to S30.
  n8  = op-amp #13's output node: RIGHT lead of 1uF #10, op-amp #13 OUT, LEFT lead of 1k #16.
  n9  = op-amp #13's summing node (in-): LEFT lead of 1uF #10, op-amp #13 in- (upper-left at (670,466)), RIGHT lead of 1k #14.
  n10 = op-amp #19's output node: LEFT lead of 1k #12, RIGHT lead of 1uH #18, op-amp #19 OUT. Physically the x~310 vertical from y~410 down to y~533, joined by the inductor at S46.
  n11 = +0V node / op-amp #19's summing node: V-DC #15 (the '+0V' arrow), LEFT lead of 1uH #18, op-amp #19 in- (upper-left at (104,517)).
  n12 = op-amp #24's summing node (in-): LEFT lead of 1uH #23, op-amp #24 in-, RIGHT plate of 1uF #25. Physically the y~755 wire from x~653 to the op-amp bar at x~697, with the x~677 riser to the inductor.
  n13 = op-amp #24's output node: RIGHT lead of 1uH #23, op-amp #24 OUT, LEFT lead of 1k #26.

CRITICAL SITE DECISIONS (all ten recorded; S21 added because it defines net n4 even though the tool did not flag it):
  S11 (120,258) deg=3 - JUNCTION. T: the drop to op-amp #4's in- leaves the y~257 feedback rail here; the rail continues right. Nothing to 'cross'.
  S20 (577,315) deg=4 - JUNCTION. A hand-drawn small ring sits on the x~577 bus exactly where the wire to 1k #6 leaves it; the bus passes vertically through the ring. Nothing continues to the LEFT at that height, so this is a tee, not a crossing - the tracer's hop=11.3 is the ring's curvature being mistaken for a wire hop. Reading it as a crossing would orphan resistor #6's left lead.
  S22 (268,324) deg=4 - JUNCTION. inkmap at (268,324) shows the 3px vertical swelling to 9-11px across y 317-331 - a genuine solder blob about 3x stroke width - where op-amp #4's feedback rail (down the x~270 column from the y~257 top rail) meets its own output wire. THE OTHER READING would split n1 into {+5V source, op-amp #4 in-} and {op-amp #4 out, resistor #8 left}, i.e. 15 nets, with op-amp #4 running open-loop. Rejected on the blob. (The few px of vertical continuing below the blob to y~370 is pen overshoot; it reaches nothing.)
  S21 (421,318) deg=4 - JUNCTION (recorded explicitly although not flagged critical). Zoom at (425,330) shows the x~420 column coming down from inductor #2's left lead and TERMINATING on the y~317 wire in a blob; the y~317 wire runs from resistor #8's right lead through that blob and on to op-amp #7's upper (in+) bar. Importantly the column does NOT continue below y~320: the wire that drops to S30 starts at a separate corner at (423,364) fed from the op-amp's LOWER (in-) lead. So inductor #2 is feedback from op-amp #7's output to its in+ - unusual (positive feedback) but unambiguously what is drawn, because this op-amp is the one triangle on the sheet with '+' drawn on the upper input and '-' on the lower.
  S23 (577,338) deg=3 - JUNCTION. T with a fat blob: op-amp #7's output arrives from the left and lands on the x~577 bus.
  S30 (422,412) deg=3 - JUNCTION. T: resistor #12's right lead lands on the x~422 column that runs from op-amp #7's in- corner down to the top of resistor #17.
  S44 (576,467) deg=4 - JUNCTION. T: the wire to 1k #14 leaves the x~577 bus here; nothing continues to the left, so no crossing is possible.
  S46 (310,471) deg=3 - JUNCTION. T with a blob: inductor #18's right lead lands on the x~310 column joining op-amp #19's output to resistor #12's left lead.
  S47 (998,479) deg=3 - JUNCTION. T: resistor #16's right lead lands on the x~998 output bus, which passes top-to-bottom.
  S48 (98,481) deg=3 - JUNCTION. T: the '+0V' arrow, inductor #18's left lead and the drop to op-amp #19's in- all meet at this corner.
  S65 (833,759) deg=4 - JUNCTION. The x~833 column from inductor #23's right lead comes down to op-amp #24's output and the wire to resistor #26 leaves rightward; all three are the same node.
  Non-critical sites, all inspected and left at default; every one is either handwriting brushing a wire or a corner inside a net that is already single: S0/S1/S2/S3 ('+5V'), S31/S32/S33/S35/S36 ('+0V'), S6/S7/S8/S12/S13/S14/S15/S38/S40/S41/S53/S54/S55/S56 ('1uH' labels on inductors #1 #2 #18 #23), S26/S27/S28/S34/S58/S59 ('1uF' labels on caps #10 #25), S16/S18/S37/S42/S43/S51/S60/S62 ('1kOhm' labels on resistors), S19/S24/S45/S49/S52/S64/S66 (input/output tees inside an already-single net).
